sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by its action on the respiratory organs and the eyes. It is useful in cases of chronic catarrh and chronic inflammation of the mucous membranes. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. The patient is often an elderly person with chronic respiratory issues.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision. Sensation of a film over the eyes.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction.
sections.Throat: Irritation and rawness in the throat. Hawking of mucus. Cough.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a profuse expectoration of mucus. Hoarseness. Chronic bronchitis.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs.
